statement: Primary benchmark uses C1-C6 seeds 13-15 and C0 once; C1 mean F1 is 0.7533. Six-seed results are separate.
C4/C5/C6 rates are 12/0/22 percent under the amended AI-review protocol, not independent human validation. Historical C2/C3 are agent review; C1 is an estimate.
The comparisons do not independently isolate contamination dose from similarity or establish a causal mechanism.
C3 unseen F1 0.7057 exceeds C0 0.6934 numerically; descriptive means do not establish statistical significance or equality. Seen evaluation uses the threshold-selection validation slice.
All-negative F1 is zero; all-positive F1 is 2*pi/(1+pi)=0.2406424, not a ceiling for useful classifiers.
Protocol/model differences are limitations and possible contributors, not proof explaining the full gap to published performance.
F1 agreement at 5e-4 does not certify precision/recall or exact count equality. Six legacy count discrepancies remain disclosed; plots use frozen NPZ arrays and thresholds.
